metadata.title: SIDE-lv-conservation: the Conservation-route growth interface and the h1-complete coupling ledger for the SIDE proof of the Riemann Hypothesis
metadata.description:
SIDE-lv-conservation: the compiled surround of the conservation clause — the SIDE programme's frontier, machine-checked.

WHAT THIS IS. A Lean 4 kernel (against Mathlib) that compiles the structure surrounding the SIDE proof's one named input: the conservation clause of A Place To Stand (concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19675355), Section 27.3 — every zero of xi forces the Euler balance, equivalently the two-channel Li positivity lambda_Z(n) >= -lambda_A(n). Rather than leaving that clause as prose, this kernel fixes it as one compiled goal state and machine-checks everything provable around it: what is established, what is certified in finite range, what is bracketed as false, and exactly where the open mathematics begins.

WHAT IT CONTAINS. h1_complete_at_Phi — all eight per-class coupling facts of the manuscript's Chapter 15, machine-checked at the fixed Mellin witness Phi and conjoined (the catalogue side complete at the witness). The register pentagon — the clause's five equivalent faces (universality, conservation, totality, positivity, spectral distance) compiled as a graded structure, deliberately without compiling the cross-register equivalences, which would be compiling RH-equivalence itself. The finite-range positivity certificate — lambda_n >= 0 proved for n up to the Voros detection threshold (about 2T^2 from zeros verified to height T), with the on-line term's nonnegativity proved in general. Growth bounds for the completed zeta and completed Dirichlet L-functions. Two machine-checked negative results bracketing retired stronger claims. And at this version, the finite-set conjunct of the explicit-formula premise is proved rather than assumed: the nontrivial zeta zeros to height T form a genuine finite set (lowFinset constructed via an entire carrier and analytic isolation of zeros; lowFinset_mem_iff).

HOW TO CHECK. lake build at pinned commit 93c27ec (tag v0.10.0); #print axioms at the named terminals — all report {propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound}, zero custom axioms, zero sorry. The one deliberately open obligation is the clause itself; the kernel's docstrings and the manuscript's Sections 25.8 and 27.3 state its exact location and status.

WHAT THIS RECORD IS FOR. It makes the proof's frontier auditable: a reader can see, in compiled form, that the catalogue side is complete, that positivity holds on-line and in the certified range, where the all-n tail begins, and which classical ingredients (Guinand–Weil decomposition, the Voros tail bound) are named as inputs pending Mathlib formalization. The clause is research in progress, mapped in the companion census Paths to the Critical Line.

THIS VERSION. v0.10.0 adds the proved finite-set conjunct (previously an assumed clause of the explicit-formula interface) — a purely additive change; every previously deposited terminal is byte-identical with its axiom profile unmoved.
